name: Snowy Nocturne
effect:
Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 6–12% for 300s.
In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
description: A specialty sparkling beverage. Berries and rye are brewed together before being blended with sparkling water. Sweet and tart on the palate with a mellow grain aroma, it contains no alcohol, yet is anything but bland.

suspicious.effect: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 6% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
suspicious.description: A specialty sparkling beverage. The drink is cloudy and lifeless, with only a few stray bubbles rising to the surface before everything goes still. It is like a song that falls out of tune on the very first note.

normal.effect: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 9% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
normal.description: A specialty sparkling beverage. Berries and rye are brewed together before being blended with sparkling water. Sweet and tart on the palate with a mellow grain aroma, it contains no alcohol, yet is anything but bland.

delicious.effect: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 12% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
delicious.description: A specialty sparkling beverage. The rosy-orange drink shimmers softly in the glass as a stream of tiny bubbles flutters eagerly toward the surface, like fine snow drifting through the night.
